entities.name: HslU ATPase
observations: The 455-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to curated HslU proteins Q4UYX6, B0RNK7, and Q8P552.
HslU is the ATPase and unfoldase component of the bacterial HslUV protease complex.
HslU is localized in the cytoplasm.
HslU forms a homohexameric ring; HslUV assembly includes HslU hexamer(s) capping HslV protease rings.
The protein contains AAA-family ATPase domains, including AAA_5 at residues 57–93 and AAA_2 at residues 196–341.

entities.name: HslUV protease complex
observations: The HslUV complex is a proteasome-like bacterial protease system in which HslU unfolds substrates and HslV hydrolyzes them.

entities.name: ATP-dependent protein unfolding
observations: HslU uses ATP binding and hydrolysis to recognize, mechanically unfold, and deliver protein substrates to HslV.

entities.name: ATP hydrolysis activity
observations: The protein has curated ATP-binding and ATP-hydrolysis annotations consistent with its AAA+ ATPase domains.
